The check passes: `python3 check.py` printed `19/19 transitions replay exactly` and `ALL PASS`.

The rule in `program.py` is as follows:

| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| 3 | The cursor moves to the previous editable glyph column. From the first column, it goes to the last column. |
| 4 | The cursor moves to the next editable glyph column. From the last column, it goes to the first column. |
| 1, 2 | No change to any object. |
| All others | No change to any object. |

I did not get data for these parts of the rule, so they are not in the program:
- **Glyph changes:** Actions 1 and 2 possibly change the selected glyph, but the extracted objects do not show a change.
- **Win check:** Possibly the game compares the editable words with the reference words.
- **Move counter:** The counter did not change in any of the 19 transitions.

The header comment of `program.py` records these three hypotheses.
